recon.notes: Platform: Squarespace shell + Elfsight Event Calendar widget, confirmed by the boot endpoint answering with app "event-calendar" for the id embedded in /calendar. The widget payload is the whole calendar: exact local times, IANA timeZone per row, and machine-readable repeat fields, so no AI/OCR is needed for dates. Elfsight repeat semantics used here: nthDayInMonth = the same ordinal weekday as the anchor start date (1st..4th); lastDayInMonth = the last anchor-weekday of each month; weeklyOn = repeatWeeklyOnDays; custom = repeatFrequency/repeatInterval/repeatEnds. Yesterday's run 20260909-072307 reported totalEvents 151 for this parser (29 kept + 121 bear-dropped after 1 duplicate removed) from urlCount 1: that is the 143 visible live-widget rows plus the 9 rows of the commented-out 2024 widget, i.e. every widget row emitted as a dated single (only BEARS NIGHT OUT, COMEDY HOUR and GORDITOS carried a recurrenceRule in the run output). This file, by contrast, folds the widget into 22 published things.

coverage.basis: All counts come from the Elfsight boot door (https://core.service.elfsight.com/p/boot/?w=e122bc50-bc4f-4cde-a6b9-ee6d4e31531a): 148 rows = 143 visible+named + 5 hidden. The 143 visible rows split into 119 past noRepeat rows (dated 2024-06-24 to 2026-09-09, including yesterday's GAY CARD: JAWBREAKER and ~9 closure notices — counted, not enumerated), 5 noRepeat rows dated on/after 2026-09-10 (the 5 singles here), and 19 repeating rows. Of the 19 repeating rows, 17 are live event series documented here (13 nthDayInMonth, 2 weeklyOn, 2 lastDayInMonth), one is the CLOSED FOR A PRIVATE EVENT closure notice (trap), and one is the custom Drag Race Viewing Party series that ended 2024-05-01 (trap). Published = 5 singles + 17 series = 22. Second door: the headless-Chrome render of /calendar shows the September 2026 month grid with exactly the instances these RRULEs predict for 2026-09-11..2026-10-03 (22 cells, all accounted for, nothing extra), which is how the nthDayInMonth ordinal reading was verified. Third door: the Squarespace /events?format=json collection is frozen (0 upcoming / 7 past, all Aug 2024) and adds nothing. The commented-out second widget (9 rows, Jun-Jul 2024) is recorded as a trap, not counted. Occurrences are materialized for 2026-09-10..2026-12-09; instances the rendered grid displayed are origin "listed" with a quote from the rendered DOM, the rest are origin "rule".

traps.label: Second Elfsight widget id inside an HTML comment on /calendar
traps.why: The /calendar HTML carries a second widget embed, elfsight-app-8c5b40b3-85f2-43cf-9a4c-d13aefd10dee, but only inside a commented-out block (the comment opens at "<!-- <script src=\"https://static.elfsight.com/platform/platform.js\"" and closes after this div). Its boot endpoint still answers with 9 rows, all dated 2024-06-05 to 2024-07-05 (Rockstrap, CLOSED FOR A PRIVATE EVENT, Gay Geek Trivia, DIAPER HAPPY HOUR, PRIDE SUNDAY, TRAVEURA: PRIDE!, ARCADE, Underbear, FRIDAY NIGHT VESPERS) — the bar's abandoned 2024 calendar. The browser never renders it. A widget-id regex that ignores HTML comments reads it as a live second calendar and emits 2024 duplicates of parties the live widget already carries.
traps.note: Run 20260909-072307 contains Gay Geek Trivia 2024-06-05, TRAVEURA: PRIDE! 2024-06-29, ARCADE 2024-06-29, PRIDE SUNDAY 2024-06-30, FRIDAY NIGHT VESPERS 2024-06-28, Underbear 2024-06-28 and Rockstrap 2024-07-05 — none of which exist in the live widget e122bc50. Boot payload saved but deliberately not enumerated.

traps.label: Squarespace /events collection (typeName events-stacked)
traps.why: The Squarespace-native events collection at /events (and its ?format=json feed) reports 0 upcoming and 7 past items, the newest dated 2024-08-07 (GAY GEEK TRIVIA, DIAPER HAPPY HOUR, ROCK THE ROCKBAR, BEARS NIGHT OUT, ARCADE, ROCKSTRAP, FRIDAY NIGHT VESPERS). The bar stopped using it in Aug 2024 and moved programming to the Elfsight widget; /events is also not in the parser's urls, so nothing there is a missing event. Each item still serves /events/<slug>?format=ical.
traps.note: Run 20260909-072307 has zero rows with a rockbarnyc.com/events/ URL (all rows are source "elfsight"), so the scraper is not reading this collection. $.upcoming is [] and $.collection.typeName is "events-stacked".

traps.label: CLOSED FOR A PRIVATE EVENT (all-day row repeating 1st Thursday)
traps.why: A closure notice, not a party: description reads "Rockbar will be closed tonight for a private event. We will reopen Friday at 5pm". The row was entered with isAllDay true, start/end 23:33, and repeatPeriod nthDayInMonth on a 1st Thursday (2026-05-07), so the widget re-paints it on every 1st Thursday (rendered grid shows it on Oct 1). It is the 19th "series" row in the widget but carries no event.
traps.note: Run 20260909-072307 carries "CLOSED FOR A PRIVATE EVENT" at 2026-05-08T03:33:00.000Z (bear-dropped). Nine other one-off closure rows (CLOSED FOR PRIDE RECOVERY!, CLOSED DUE TO WEATHER, CLOSED FOR CHRISTMAS DAY, CLOSED X-MAS EVE, CLOSED FOR THANKSGIVING, CLOSED FOR LABOR DAY, CLOSED for Pride Recovery!) sit among the past noRepeat rows and are counted with them.

traps.label: Drag Race Viewing Party (repeatPeriod "custom", ended 2024-05-01)
traps.why: The one "custom" repeat row is a finished weekly series: repeatFrequency "weekly", repeatInterval 1, repeatWeeklyOnDays ["fr"], repeatEnds "onDate" with repeatEndsDate 2024-05-01, anchored 2024-02-02. It expresses as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=FR;UNTIL=20240501 but every instance is in 2024, the widget renders none of them, and it must never be treated as a live series.

expect.note: Extracted as a single past row dated 2024-02-02 is the same treatment the 119 past one-offs get under allowPastEvents; an rrule or any 2026 date for it would be wrong.

traps.note: Run 20260909-072307 kept "Drag Race Viewing Party" at 2024-02-03T00:00:00.000Z (the anchor date, no recurrence), which is the correct shape for an ended series.
